description: A bonus taken as cash against some of it paid into the pension instead, over the whole year: what reaches the pocket either way once the £100,000 line, the childcare that stops there and the Child Benefit charge are counted, and the sacrifice that brings the year back under each line. Use for 'should I put my bonus in my pension', 'how much of my bonus do I keep'.

bonus.description: The bonus before tax, in pounds.

children.description: Children Child Benefit is claimed for. Defaults to 0.

employerNiSharePct.description: Share of the employer's NI saving passed into the pension, 0 to 100. Defaults to 0.

fundedHoursValue.description: What the nursery would charge a year for funded hours, which also stop over £100,000. Defaults to 0.

niCapFrom2029.description: Use the rule from 6 April 2029: only the first £2,000 a year sacrificed is free of NI. Defaults to false.

sacrificed.description: How much of the bonus goes into the pension instead. Defaults to 0, which shows the bonus as cash and the sacrifice each line needs.

salary.description: Gross salary for the year without the bonus, in pounds.

scotland.description: Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.

studentLoanPlan.description: Undergraduate student loan plan, if any.

taxFreeChildcareChildren.description: Children in Tax-Free Childcare, which stops over £100,000. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_bonus_sacrifice
title: Bonus sacrifice
